text:
Anya V: Heads up — sampleapp onboarding logs spiked during token refresh. Seeing lots of INFO from auth-client and then downstream HTTP retries lose X-Request-ID. Repro steps in env staging-2. :frown:

Sam R: Ugh. Do you have a log snippet?

Anya V: Sure, pasted below. Notice missing req-id after the 401->refresh sequence.

```
[2026-03-18T14:12:02.123Z] INFO auth-client Token refresh succeeded
[2026-03-18T14:12:02.125Z] INFO http-client GET /v1/predict 401 -> retry
[2026-03-18T14:12:02.126Z] DEBUG http-client headers: Authorization: Bearer ****
[2026-03-18T14:12:02.127Z] DEBUG http-client (no X-Request-ID)
```

Ben (devex): Is this the OTEL auto-instrumentation hooking in? We had a change that reorders header-copy vs. redaction hook last week.

Anya V: Yes — on the stack we use node-auto-otel + our log-hook. The hook ordering seems flipped: auto-instrumentation mutates headers during refresh and our log hook runs before the request-id middleware.

Olivia T: Can you try forcing our log hook to run earlier? i.e., in sampleapp start sequence do `require('./telemetry').init({hookOrder: 'pre'})` — should be quick test.

Anya V: Tried that, reduces loss but breaks redaction in some rare traces — some PII gets through in traces.

Infra Bot: Deployment 3821 rolled to staging-2 at 2026-03-18T14:00:00Z :white_check_mark:

Sam R: Ok two things: 1) short-term: change log hook order in sampleapp quickstart; 2) medium-term: make our OTEL wrapper preserve X-Request-ID and inject it into retries at http-client layer.

Ben (devex): Filed GH issue: redwood/devex#842 — includes failing logs, sampleapp patch and possible fix to hook registration order.

Anya V: Adding PR link: https://github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/156 — quick-start patch that reorders require().

Olivia T: QA will run through staging perf after PR.

QA CI: smoke tests queued for sampleapp PR 156 — ETA 12m.

Sam R: Also flagging we should add an automated unit test for the retry path to assert X-Request-ID preserved.

Anya V: Agree. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
